text:
ravi: Support reported two doc issues after the last deploy: broken pricing quota anchor and metering examples using the old header + legacy method. can someone pick this up?
tess: drop the exact links?
ravi: /pricing#quota-breakdown 404s. /docs/metering/headers.md shows Authorization: Bearer <KEY> and generate_text() in snippets.
omar: that panel rename to consumption_* is the culprit. prefer adding redirects entries rather than editing lots of external links. i'll add redirects.yml entries for the old anchors.
evans: i'll update the metering snippets to use client.generate(...) and show headers as { 'x-api-key': process.env.RW_KEY } in both python and ts. include a short migration note in /docs/migration/headers.md.
tess: Support also asked for a tiny burst credits worked example. keep it short: formula + one numeric example + a tiny python helper.
docs-bot: PR #4680 opened by evan — "docs: pricing anchor redirect + metering header SDK updates". Reviewers requested: @omar, @tess. CI: queued.
omar: add a redirects unit test and run it locally before pushing. tests were flaky last week.
evans: will do. checklist in PR desc: 1) add redirects.yml entry, 2) update pricing anchors, 3) swap SDK snippets to client.generate + x-api-key, 4) add burst worked example, 5) add migration blurb, 6) backport to docs-1.2 after merge.
ravi: thanks — ping when CI is green and i'll QA staging preview. :thumbsup:
